training: Expanding yearly fits. For each development year train only endpoint < first decision in year. No 2024+ decision labels or current inputs used. Finalists additionally checked with per-date refresh.
selection: Original V15 gates plus all-profile return >=0, all-profile drawdown >=-0.01, 12M return/drawdown >=0, weekly return>=0. Select on development utility and lower adverse-date concentration; no exposed/current selection. Failures trigger a documented new development-only research round, not threshold changes.
labels: Original balanced ordinal utility for refresh/specialist. Others 0.70 return percentile +0.20 inverse shortfall percentile +0.10 drawdown percentile. Linear gains for normalized rankers, continuous target for monotone regression.
normalization: Within-query percentiles, missing inputs exactly neutral0.5. No history-age, true-history flags, stock identity, current fundamental, or sector feature. Original observed-field confidence caps correction weight.
ranknet: CPU MLP32/16 SiLU; 8 epochs;600 pairs per query per epoch; signed utility pair logistic loss weighted by absolute utility gap; AdamW0.001 weight_decay0.01; no early stopping on development.
protected_inputs: V16 completed audit baseline plus all V16 experiment files/report/runner; no previous experiment edits.
